text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo was aiming for
the Japan Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Ticket-zo.
Taishin and Hayahide are the same!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
We can definitely look forward to a heated showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through the Twinkle Series, the three eventually came to be known as BNW.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hordes of fans packed into the Nippon Derby,
eager to catch a glimpse of their race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this, Winning Ticket, who had been
waiting in the green room, looked at me with an
unusually serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'm giving everyone something to dream about,
just like that Umamusume did back then?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Will they cheer for me?
Will their hearts race when they watch me run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her so fidgety and restless, I switched on the live broadcast from Tokyo Racecourse for her.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
—The Nippon Derby is finally about to begin,
and massive crowds have packed the stands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The camera panned across the crowd, whipping their anticipation into a frenzy.
Catching glimpses of banners here and there, among them—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah!! "Do your best, Ticket-zo!" it says...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was an exceptionally eye-catching, large banner
made specially for Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Heeey!! You better win, Ticket-zo!!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: These passionate cheers are sure to reach Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! It's reaching me, totally reaching me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tears quickly well up in Winning Ticket's
eyes as she stares intently at the TV."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh!! *sniff* I'm so happy!
Everyone is just so excited...!!
choice_data_list: Pour everything you've got for the Derby into it!
Now go pour all your feelings for the Derby into it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I can do this! I will!
I'm gonna give it everything I've goooooooot!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEEEEEERRRRRRBYYYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if answering Winning Ticket's fighting spirit, loud cheers erupted from the broadcast as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally, the Derby gates open...!
